verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v1: yaʾayyuhā l-ʾawladu ʾinna sumuwwakum yazdādu bil-ʾikhlaṣi wal-ʾinṣāfi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v2: ʾūṣīkumu bithalathati min shaʾanihā tashīlu sayrikumu ʾilā l-ʾahdāfi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v3: ʾūṣīkumu bitaʾaddubi watafakkuri wataʿʿamuqi fī l-baḥthi kal-ʾaslafi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v4: fal-marʾu bil-fawḍā yudhillu ḥayātahu wayubaddilu l-ʾiṣlaḥa bil-ʾitlafi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v5: mā zānakum mithlu s-sakīnati fī d-dujā mā shānakum mithlu r-riḍā bihutāfi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v6: ṣ-ṣamtu ḥukmu la yuqārabu sulṭata fabihi tuḍammu ṣiyānatu biʿafāfi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v7: wan-nuṭqu bil-ḥikami s-saniyyati lazimu ʾila maʿa l-ʾawshābi wal-ʾajlafi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v8: sāda l-ʿamā wal-jahlu fī ʾawsāṭikum ʾinna l-ʿamā wal-jahla sharru jafāfi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v9: mā ʾantajā ʾila ḍ-ḍaghīnata wal-hawā mā ʾaʿmala ʾila ʾadhā bikhilafi
verses.ya-ayyuha-l-awladu-inna-sumuwwakum-c1-v1: mā ḍalla ʾila man ʾuḍilla ʿalā hudā waṣfu yuqabbaḥu jāniba l-ʾawṣāfi
la tarkanū naḥwa t-tashayyukhi ʾinnamā ʿuqbāhu ḍuʿfu ʿāʾidu liḍiʿāfi
wazinū l-ḥayāta bikulli qusṭāsi wala tazinū l-ḥayāta binakhwati wakafāfi
wataʿʿalamū ḥirafā wasīḥū wāʿmalū wafqā limā fī sūrati l-ʾīlafi
wādʿū ʾilahā yastajību duʿāʾakum nūrā watawfīqā bila ʾikhlafi
wataḍarraʿū kulla t-taḍarruʿi ʿindahu liyaʿʿumakum bijalaʾili l-ʾalṭāfi
watawassalū bil-hāshimiyyī muḥammadi wataʾayyadū min baʿdu bil-ʾakhlafi
faʿalayhi khayru ṣalati rabbī dāʾimā waʿalā ṣ-ṣaḥābati mithluhā bil-kāfi
